svg.aria-label: Upper voice: E4 4 to 10 s, F4 14 to 20 s, E4 26 to 32 s (rests in between). Lower voice: C4 0 to 12 s, B3 12 to 24 s, C4 24 to 36 s. Dashed markers at 12 and 24 seconds: the upper voice is resting at both. F4 sounds only from 14 to 20 seconds, over B3: B3 + F4, a diminished fifth, 6 semitones, in the tritone colour.
svg.title: The truth check: the lower voice moves while the upper rests

g.text: Check: when does the lower voice change?
At 12 s and 24 s the upper voice rests. F4 sounds only from 14 s to 20 s, over B3.
How to read this graphic: Look at the two dashed markers. At each, the upper lane is a
dashed rest box: no upper note is sounding. Then find the one band, 14 to 20 seconds,
where F4 sits over B3. Nothing sounds as F4 over C4 in this version.
